verdict.rationale: Fellow lets admins set org‑wide recording/retention policies and choose between a visible bot or bot‑less desktop capture, and users can pause/resume recording mid‑meeting, but there is no documented feature for actively notifying or disclosing to meeting participants (e.g., an in‑meeting consent banner or automated notification) beyond the optional visible bot indicator. missing for 10: explicit participant notification/disclosure mechanism, admin-enforced consent prompts, evidence of enforcement beyond policy settings.
